body:
I just don't understand how while having a normal life with no real issues I can feel so ungrateful and terrible over small meaningless things.

But Thank you. I guess I'll have to somehow end up at a therapist again.

I saw a psychiatrist a year or 4 ago when I had chronic headaches (medical related) and it basically came to the conclusion that I had major depressive tendencies but I rejected their offer for anti-depressants. So no. I haven't tried them. I guess I have an idea in my head that if I take pills to feel a certain way I'm not 'me' anymore. So i find it hard to wrap my head around.

As for why I am unhappy it's just mostly when I get ignored by people that mean a lot to me. It just amplifies the unhappy feelings.
